'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 James Booker DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
